title: add nvtx counters, microbench instrumentation, and perf dashboard for runtime
author: Anika Shah
description: Motivation: We need better visibility into per-request runtime behavior (kernel launch times, KV cache hits/misses, continuous batching latency tails) to guide scheduling and kernel-selection optimizations. This PR adds NVTX ranges and lightweight counters across the serving runtime, a small set of microbenchmarks to exercise hot paths, and a Grafana dashboard to visualize perf metrics. Changes cover NVTX push/pop around major runtime phases, atomic counters for KV cache hits/misses and batch sizes, microbench harnesses for kernel latency and kv-cache lookup, and a CI perf-smoke job to collect representative traces. Checklist: - [x] Add NVTX ranges and names for request lifecycle (request_receive, routing, batch_assemble, kv_cache_lookup, kernel_invoke, postprocess) - [x] Add atomic counters and per-worker metrics (kv_hit, kv_miss, batching_size_histogram) - [x] Add microbench binary under tools/perf that runs kernel and kv microtests and emits JSON summaries - [x] Add Grafana dashboard JSON and query templates under observability/dashboards/runtime_perf.json - [x] Add CI perf-smoke job to run microbench and upload traces on merge - [x] Add docs/notes describing how to interpret metrics and NVTX markers. This is intentionally low-risk instrumentation: no behavioral changes to scheduling or kernel selection. The counters are additive and NVTX calls are sharded to minimize overhead. The microbench binaries are opt-in and run only in CI perf-smoke and locally by engineers. Why now: recent latency regressions observed in ENG-3124 and field reports showed increased kernel tail latency; better visibility is required before changing scheduling heuristics. How tested: local runs of tools/perf/microbench against a small model on dev GPUs; end-to-end CI perf-smoke runs on a subset of buildkite agents; manual traces inspected in Nsight and Grafana dashboards. Rollout plan: merge to main behind a feature-flagged metrics pipeline; enable dashboard for SRE and performance team; follow-up PRs will add sampling of traces and automated alerting when tail latency regresses.
